svg.title: BN254 Groth16 verification, Narsil against MCL and arkworks
svg.desc: Grouped bar chart of 7 operations on AMD EPYC 9654, in microseconds, where a shorter bar is faster. Each group holds Narsil, MCL and arkworks. On one Groth16 proof, one public input, Narsil takes 298 microseconds against 741 for MCL and 1168 for arkworks, so 2.5 times faster than MCL and 3.9 times faster than arkworks.
